item: R1 - temporal geometry of the pulse train

parameters.shiftToleranceUnchanged: the pre-registered value 3 is not altered by this test

instrument: frames counted at a real jsnes emulator running a synthetic ROM, not re-derived from the adapter arithmetic
checks: actual emulated frame count per window
frame-by-frame button-state sequence per window, compared frame by frame rather than as run-lengths, because a positive shift is issued as a separate call of the same button state
the adapter report agrees with the emulator
the same frame count with the production neutral mask of 0
a shift larger than the release is refused rather than clamped

regression.defect: a negative shift was applied to the release of every pulse

impossibleShiftError: SHIFT_EXCEEDS_RELEASE: a tail shift of -3 cannot be absorbed by a release of 2 frames; the window would not be the declared one
